content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-77. - Maximum interest rate.
content.summary:
No bond shall bear interest at any time at a rate exceeding the maximum interest rate
               as shall be established by the council for the series of bonds of which such bond
               is a part.
(Code 1981, § 27-78; Ord. No. 551, § 28, 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 1643, § 5, 2-18-1980;
        …
